title: Acme Shop: move the orders database from MySQL 5.7 to PostgreSQL 16
intro_html:
Fictional demo. Acme Shop, its people, its numbers and its findings are invented.

The migration agent read the order service, ran checks against a PostgreSQL 16 staging copy and wrote a plan. This form has one card for each finding and each decision in that plan. Read a card, then answer below it. Your answers are saved inside this HTML file.

Start with F6 (Critical) and D1 (the cutover method). The other decisions depend on D1.

labels.name: TESTED
labels.meaning: A script or a test ran and its output is saved.

labels.name: READ
labels.meaning: Found by reading the code or a document.

labels.name: INFERRED
labels.meaning: A conclusion from reasoning. Not tested.

sections.title: Part A — Findings
sections.intro: Each card is one finding from the audit. Tell me if you agree with it and with the proposed action.

sections.title: Part B — Decisions only you can make
sections.intro: Select one option for each decision. The recommended option has a mark. The plan in the report uses the recommended options.

sections.title: Part C — Notes
sections.intro: Read these cards. Confirm that you read them, or write a comment.

choices.label: Agree with the problem, but change the action
